text: Start, demodulating, the header of this packet, because everyone needs to demodulate packet headers. Not the payload because the packet is not for them, okay. But everyone needs to demodulate the header of the packets that transmit the message. And in the header, there is a field, an information included, that is called duration. And this part of the header, this piece of information included in the header, tells for how long the channel is expected to be occupied by that transmission. Okay, actually by that dialog. So, B and C, upon demodulating the header of this data packet, they read the duration field. And they use it to set a counter at the MAC layer, okay, at the MAC layer. A counter that is called NAF, Network and Location Vector, it's just a counter. So if in this duration field, we have a value, let's say, that says five timeslots. B and C set this counter that they have got.
